00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000034.title: Chapter 04 – The ledger
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000034.synopsis: Nan Hollis shows Mara the ledger of places and the names beside them. Mara’s own name is beside the eastern spit, and it has not been crossed out.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000034.notes: Chapter-as-file: three scenes separated by breaks. Nan says in one page what Elin would take three chapters to say.

00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000035.title: Chapter 05 – The eastern spit
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000035.synopsis: Mara walks to where the tower used to be and finds the sixty-one steps, going down into the sea. Elin meets her there.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000035.notes: Chapter-as-file, two scenes. The first time Mara measures something and the island lets her.
